siftec.milestone.advanced_aluminum_produ: Pressurised nitrogen opens a new chapter in aluminum production. Find a well, pressurise it, extract it.
Resource Well Pressurizer and Extractor; Empty Fluid Tank, packaged Nitrogen Gas, Heat Sink, Cooling System and Fused Modular Frame; nitrogen wells on the scanner
siftec.milestone.advanced_steel_producti: Better steel makes better machines. The Miner Mk.2 digs faster and brings up more from every node.
Miner Mk.2, Crushing Wheels; Encased Industrial Beam, Stator, Motor and Automated Wiring
siftec.milestone.aeronautical_engineerin: When roads, rails and belts are not enough, take to the air. Drones carry packages between Drone Ports.
Drone Port (a Build Gun building) and Drone (Create's package network), sulfur nodes on the scanner
siftec.milestone.base_building.desc: A factory is only as good as the floor it stands on. Foundations, walls and ramps keep production level, tidy and up to FICSIT standards.
siftec.milestone.base_building.unlocks: Foundations, walls and roofs (Build Gun, Foundations tab), Lookout Tower; girders, scaffolding, ladders, casings, copycat blocks, windows, doors and seats
Iron is fine. Steel is better. The Foundry turns iron and coal into steel for the heavier work ahead.
Foundry (Mechanical Mixer); Steel Ingot, Steel Beam, Steel Pipe and Versatile Framework
siftec.milestone.bauxite_refinement.desc: Bauxite makes aluminum, and aluminum makes everything lighter. A demanding process, and a rewarding one.
siftec.milestone.bauxite_refinement.unlo: Alumina Solution, Aluminum Scrap, Aluminum Ingot, Alclad Aluminum Sheet and Aluminum Casing; bauxite and quartz nodes on the scanner
siftec.milestone.coal_power.desc: Biomass will only take you so far. Coal Generators burn coal and water for steady power, and pumps and pipes bring them the water.
siftec.milestone.coal_power.unlocks: Coal Generator, Water Extractor, Fluid Pipe, Mechanical Pump, Fluid Tank (one block wide until Petroleum Power), Hose Pulley, Steam Engine and Blaze Burner, coal nodes on the scanner
siftec.milestone.contraption_transit.des: FICSIT's research shows Pioneers prefer to arrive. Elevators, rope pulleys and gantries move you and your cargo up, down and along.
siftec.milestone.contraption_transit.unl: Replaces Hypertubes: Elevator Pulley and Elevator Contact, Rope Pulley, Gantry Shaft and Gantry Carriage
siftec.milestone.control_system_developm: Complex factories need clever parts. The Blender mixes the chemistry, and the Supercomputer does the thinking.
Blender; Sulfuric Acid, Battery, Radio Control Unit, Supercomputer and Assembly Director System
siftec.milestone.disabled: nothing: it is switched off in this pack
siftec.milestone.enhanced_asset_security: The local wildlife does not respect property rights. The Xeno-Basher explains them.
Xeno-Basher (Pneumatic Hammer) and the melee weapons
siftec.milestone.expanded_power_infrastr: Keep power for when you need it and carry it further than ever: Power Storage evens out the grid, and Power Towers span the distance.
Power Storage, Power Tower and Power Tower Platform; Mechanical Piston, Mechanical Bearing and Clockwork Bearing; chassis, Super Glue, Sticker and Contraption Controls
siftec.milestone.ficsit_blueprints.desc: Good designs deserve to be repeated. Save a section of your factory as a blueprint and build it again wherever it is needed.
siftec.milestone.ficsit_blueprints_mk2.d: Bigger factories need bigger blueprints. The Blueprint Designer Mk.2 has room for them.
siftec.milestone.ficsit_blueprints_mk3.d: Your designs, at a size the Mk.2 could only dream of.
siftec.milestone.field_research.desc: This planet is full of things FICSIT does not own yet. The MAM studies them, the Object Scanner finds them, and the Map makes sure you find your way back.
siftec.milestone.field_research.unlocks: MAM, Object Scanner, Toolbox, the Map (minimap and fullscreen map, M); backpack to Iron (45 slots)
siftec.milestone.fluid_packaging.desc: Fluids are hard to carry. Canisters are not. The Packager fills them at one end and empties them at the other.
siftec.milestone.fluid_packaging.unlocks: Packager (Spout and Item Drain), Empty Canister and packaged fluids, Liquid Biofuel, Portable Fluid Interface
siftec.milestone.hazmat_suit.desc: Some parts of this planet are bad for your health. The Hazmat Suit keeps them on the outside.
siftec.milestone.hover_pack.desc: Why walk when you can hover? The Hover Pack keeps you in the air while you work, and your backpack grows once more.
siftec.milestone.hover_pack.unlocks: Hover Pack; backpack to Netherite (99 slots)
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_1.desc: Welcome to your new workplace, Pioneer. The HUB now has an Equipment Workshop and a Portable Miner: dig by hand until the machines can do it for you. FICSIT believes in you.
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_1.unlocks: Equipment Workshop, Portable Miner, Personal Storage Box, Wrench and Goggles, Mechanical Drill
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_2.desc: Ore is only the beginning. The Smelter turns it into ingots, and the HUB gets its first Biomass Burner and the Power Lines to carry what it makes.
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_2.unlocks: Smelter, Power Line (wire and connectors), Electric Motor, Copper Ingot, Wire and Cable, copper nodes on the scanner, the first HUB Biomass Burner, Encased Fan and Nozzle
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_3.desc: One part at a time is how empires are built. The Constructor presses parts while you get on with something more productive, like building more Constructors.
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_3.unlocks: Constructor, Power Pole, Screw and Reinforced Iron Plate, Mechanical Press, Saw, Depot, Millstone and Basin, stone nodes on the scanner
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_4.desc: Carrying things is a waste of a perfectly good Pioneer. Mk.1 belts move items by themselves, no shaft needed, at 60 items a minute.
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_4.unlocks: Belt Mk.1: belts with no shaft run by themselves at 60 items/min; Andesite Funnel
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_5.desc: Digging by hand has served its purpose. The Miner Mk.1 sits on a resource node and works around the clock, and Storage Containers catch everything it digs.
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_5.unlocks: Miner Mk.1, Storage Container, Item Vault, a second HUB Biomass Burner
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_6.desc: The HUB is complete, and so is your probation. Build the Wormhole Gateway: FICSIT has a destination in mind. From now on every milestone takes a little time to ship.
siftec.milestone.hub_upgrade_6.unlocks: Wormhole Gateway, Biomass Burner (6,144 SU), Biomass, Flywheel. Milestones lock the HUB from here on
siftec.milestone.industrial_manufacturin: Some products are too complex for an Assembler. The Manufacturer combines up to four inputs into the parts the Wormhole needs most.
Manufacturer (Mechanical Crafter and Sequenced Assembly); Computer, Heavy Modular Frame, Modular Engine and Adaptive Control Unit
siftec.milestone.jetpack.desc: Gravity is only a suggestion. The Jetpack lets you ignore it for a while, and your backpack grows to carry more.
siftec.milestone.jump_pads.desc: Walking is for Pioneers with time to spare. Jump Pads put you where you need to be; the Landing Pad makes sure you arrive in one piece.
siftec.milestone.jump_pads.unlocks: Jump Pad (Weighted Ejector), U-Jelly Landing Pad
siftec.milestone.leading_edge_production: The fastest miner FICSIT has ever built, and the motors and rockets to match.
Miner Mk.3; Turbo Motor and Thermal Propulsion Rocket
siftec.milestone.logistics.desc: Items should go where they are needed, not where they happen to fall. Split, merge and lift your belts, and measure every shaft while you are at it.
siftec.milestone.logistics.unlocks: Splitter and Merger (Andesite Tunnel), Conveyor Lift (Chute and fan lift), Item Hatch, Speedometer and Stressometer
siftec.milestone.logistics_mk2.desc: Faster belts, faster factory, happier FICSIT. Belts with no shaft now run at 120 items a minute.
siftec.milestone.logistics_mk2.unlocks: Belt Mk.2: belts with no shaft run at 120 items/min
siftec.milestone.logistics_mk3.desc: Throughput is a state of mind. Belts now run at 270 items a minute, and the Industrial Storage Container holds what they bring.
siftec.milestone.logistics_mk3.unlocks: Belt Mk.3: belts with no shaft run at 270 items/min; Industrial Storage Container
siftec.milestone.logistics_mk4.desc: Belts at 480 items a minute, and the Truck for the loads a Tractor cannot manage.
siftec.milestone.logistics_mk4.unlocks: Belt Mk.4: belts with no shaft run at 480 items/min; Truck
siftec.milestone.logistics_mk5.desc: 780 items a minute. FICSIT's engineers had to find a new word for fast.
siftec.milestone.logistics_mk5.unlocks: Belt Mk.5: belts with no shaft run at 780 items/min
siftec.milestone.mam_alien_alien_power_m: Alien Power Matrix (Quantum Encoder): raises an Augmenter's boost to 30%
siftec.milestone.mam_alien_depot_expansi: The cloud holds 2 stacks of each item
siftec.milestone.mam_alien_dimensional_d: Dimensional Depot: uploads the Item Vault it sits on to the company's cloud
siftec.milestone.mam_alien_manual_depot_: Upload from your inventory: shift-click an item in the cloud window
siftec.milestone.mam_alien_mercer_sphere: The Object Scanner finds Mercer Spheres
siftec.milestone.mam_alien_netherite_syn: Netherite Ingot (Manufacturer: 4 gold ingot, 2 diamond, 20 Steel Ingot, 16 netherrack); no ancient debris needed
siftec.milestone.mam_alien_pocket_storag: Shulker Shell (Assembler: 1 SAM Fluctuator, 5 Iron Sheet), so shulker boxes need no End trip
siftec.milestone.mam_alien_power_augment: Alien Power Augmenter (built with 10 Somersloops and parts): flat SU, and +10% to its grid
siftec.milestone.mam_caterium_brass.unlo: Brass blend, Brass Ingot and Brass Sheet; Create's brass blocks
siftec.milestone.mam_caterium_caterium_e: Electron Tube and Precision Mechanism; Smart Fluid Pipe, Controller Rail, Smart Observer and Threshold Switch
siftec.milestone.mam_caterium_power_line: Ride Power Lines with a Wrench
siftec.milestone.mam_caterium_priority_p: Sequenced Gearshift, Adjustable Chain Gearshift and Speed Governor
siftec.milestone.mam_caterium_smart_spli: Brass Tunnel, Brass Funnel and Filter
Windmill Bearing and sails, at twice Create's SU
siftec.milestone.mam_megafauna_bio_organ: Alien DNA Capsule; Biomass from Alien Protein and mob drops
siftec.milestone.mam_megafauna_ender_ana: Eye of Ender (Assembler: 1 ender pearl, 2 Quartz Crystal; no blaze powder)
siftec.milestone.mam_megafauna_hostile_o: The Object Scanner finds hostile mobs
siftec.milestone.mam_megafauna_spider_re: Alien Protein from spider eye or string
siftec.milestone.mam_megafauna_the_rebar: Rebar Gun (the Nailgun) and Iron Rebar
siftec.milestone.mam_megafauna_undying_b: Totem of Undying (Manufacturer: 10 Alien DNA Capsule, 4 block of gold, 8 emerald, 5 AI Limiter)
siftec.milestone.mam_mycelia_diving_gear: Diving Helmet and Diving Boots, and the netherite backtank and diving gear
siftec.milestone.mam_mycelia_elytra_back: Elytra Backpack (Manufacturer: 1 Elytra, 1 Copper Backtank, 25 Precision Mechanism, 10 High-Speed Connector): Elytra and backtank in one chest item
siftec.milestone.mam_mycelia_synthetic_p: Fabric from Polymer Resin in the Refinery
siftec.milestone.mam_mycelia_toxic_cellu: Toxic Shot, the pack's gas round (Gunsmithing has no gas grenade)
siftec.milestone.mam_mycelia_wingsuit_re: Elytra (Manufacturer: 25 Fabric, 10 Alclad Aluminum Sheet, 4 Motor, 8 phantom membrane)
siftec.milestone.mam_nutrients_apple_res: Apple trees on the Object Scanner
siftec.milestone.mam_nutrients_automated: Cooking pot meals on the heated Mixer, cutting board recipes on the Deployer, and the secret ingredients (glowstone, blaze powder, nether wart: hold one and the food in your other hand, and use)
siftec.milestone.mam_nutrients_bulk_ferm: Bulk Fermenter; vinegar, bottled at the Spout
siftec.milestone.mam_nutrients_cider_and: Cider and mead from the Bulk Fermenter, bottled at the Spout
siftec.milestone.mam_nutrients_glow_berr: Glow berries on the Object Scanner
siftec.milestone.mam_nutrients_preserved: Pickles and jams on the Spout. Sneak and use a jar to throw it
siftec.milestone.mam_nutrients_sweet_ber: Sweet berry bushes on the Object Scanner
siftec.milestone.mam_quartz_crystal_osci: Crystal Oscillator; Redstone Link and Create's redstone parts
siftec.milestone.mam_quartz_display_syst: Display Link, Display Board and Nixie Tube; the Explorer
siftec.milestone.mam_quartz_heart_of_the: Heart of the Sea (Manufacturer: 8 Nautilus Shell, 16 prismarine crystals, 10 Crystal Oscillator, 50 Quickwire) and the Conduit
siftec.milestone.mam_quartz_quartz_cryst: Quartz Crystal (Deployer with Sand Paper); Sand Paper and Rose Quartz
siftec.milestone.mam_quartz_radar_techno: Radar Tower (clears the map's fog over about a kilometre round it, showing its crash sites and geysers)
siftec.milestone.mam_quartz_tidal_resear: Trident (Manufacturer: 10 Steel Pipe, 5 Crystal Oscillator, 50 Quickwire, 16 prismarine shard)
siftec.milestone.mam_sulfur_black_powder: Black Powder: gunpowder from sulfur, coal or charcoal, and bone meal
siftec.milestone.mam_sulfur_explosives.u: TNT from the Spout, Frag Grenade
siftec.milestone.mam_sulfur_geothermal_p: Geothermal Generator (Geyser Engine) over a sulfur geyser; geysers on the Object Scanner
siftec.milestone.mam_sulfur_heavy_weapon: Gatling, Launcher and the other heavy guns
siftec.milestone.mam_sulfur_ignimbrite.u: Ignimbrite; fire charges, magma blocks and lava
siftec.milestone.matter_conversion.desc: Turn one resource into another. The Converter makes scarcity a thing of the past, and SAM is the key.
siftec.milestone.matter_conversion.unloc: Converter; Ficsite, Diamonds, Time Crystal, Biochemical Sculptor, Reanimated SAM and SAM Fluctuator; SAM nodes on the scanner
siftec.milestone.monorail_train_technolo: Trains move more cargo further than anything else on this planet. Lay the track, build the stations and set the schedules.
Train Track, Train Station, Train Controls and Schedule; train doors, Mechanical Roller, Railway Casing and Postboxes
siftec.milestone.nuclear_power.desc: The most power FICSIT has ever let a Pioneer handle. Mind the waste: it is your responsibility, forever.
siftec.milestone.nuclear_power.unlocks: Nuclear Power Plant (512,000 SU); Encased Uranium Cell, Electromagnetic Control Rod, Uranium Fuel Rod and Magnetic Field Generator; uranium nodes on the scanner
siftec.milestone.obstacle_clearing.desc: Nature has been slow to recognise FICSIT's claim to this land. Help it along with harvesters and ploughs, and burn whatever you clear as Solid Biofuel.
siftec.milestone.obstacle_clearing.unloc: Solid Biofuel; Mechanical Harvester, Mechanical Plough and Tree Fertilizer
siftec.milestone.oil_processing.desc: Deep under the surface lies crude oil, the raw material of modern life. Pump it up and refine it into plastic, rubber and fuel.
siftec.milestone.oil_processing.unlocks: Oil Extractor (pumpjack, oil nodes only), Refinery, Fluid Valve; Plastic, Rubber, Fuel, Heavy Oil Residue, Petroleum Coke and Circuit Board; oil nodes on the scanner
siftec.milestone.part_assembly.desc: Two parts in, one better part out. The Assembler puts components together, and Smart Plating is exactly what the Wormhole Gateway is asking for.
siftec.milestone.part_assembly.unlocks: Assembler (Deployer); Copper Sheet, Rotor, Modular Frame and Smart Plating
siftec.milestone.particle_enrichment.des: Smash particles into each other until they become something more valuable. The Particle Accelerator handles the smashing.
siftec.milestone.particle_enrichment.unl: Particle Accelerator; Nitric Acid, Non-Fissile Uranium, Plutonium, Copper Powder, Pressure Conversion Cube and Nuclear Pasta
siftec.milestone.peak_efficiency.desc: The height of FICSIT logistics: belts at 1,200 items a minute, and Ficsonium for those who still want more.
siftec.milestone.peak_efficiency.unlocks: Belt Mk.6: belts with no shaft run at 1,200 items/min; Ficsonium and the Ficsonium Fuel Rod
siftec.milestone.petroleum_power.desc: Burn fuel, make power, keep growing. The Fuel Generator gives far more power than any coal plant.
siftec.milestone.petroleum_power.unlocks: Fuel Generator (51,200 SU), Diesel Engines; larger Fluid Tanks (up to 3 by 3; one block wide before)
siftec.milestone.phase_1.desc: The Wormhole Gateway needs proof that this colony is serious. Deliver Smart Plating to raise the ring's cradle and open Tiers 3 and 4.
siftec.milestone.phase_2.desc: The cradle holds. Framework, plating and wiring raise the bottom third of the ring and open Tiers 5 and 6.
siftec.milestone.phase_3.desc: A third of the ring stands. Engines and control units raise the next third and open Tiers 7 and 8.
siftec.milestone.phase_4.desc: Close the ring and run the energy conduits into it. One last tier opens: Tier 9.
siftec.milestone.phase_5.desc: Everything you have built comes down to this. Deliver the final parts and the Gateway opens onto The Sift. FICSIT thanks you for your continued service.
siftec.milestone.phase_5.unlocks: Opens the portal to The Sift
siftec.milestone.pipeline_engineering_mk: More pressure, more flow, more production. Pumps now move twice as much, twice as far.
Pipeline and Pump Mk.2: Mechanical Pump flow and range doubled
siftec.milestone.quantum_encoding.desc: Production at the scale of the very small. The Quantum Encoder builds with excited photonic matter what was impossible yesterday.
siftec.milestone.quantum_encoding.unlock: Quantum Encoder; Excited Photonic Matter, Dark Matter, Superposition Oscillator, Neural-Quantum Processor and AI Expansion Server
siftec.milestone.railway_signalling.desc: Two trains on one track is a FICSIT safety incident waiting to happen. Signals keep them apart.
siftec.milestone.resource_sink_bonus_pro: Waste is only value nobody has collected yet. Feed your surplus to the AWESOME Sink and spend the coupons at the AWESOME Shop.
AWESOME Sink and AWESOME Shop (cosmetics only)
siftec.milestone.spatial_energy_regulati: Space is only distance FICSIT has not shortened yet. Portals join the far ends of your factory in an instant.
Main Portal and Satellite Portal; Singularity Cell and Ballistic Warp Drive
siftec.milestone.vehicular_transport.des: Some resources are inconveniently far away. The Tractor hauls them home, Truck Stations load and unload it, and a recorded route means it drives itself.
siftec.milestone.vehicular_transport.unl: Tractor, Truck Station, Cart Assembler minecart contraptions, Portable Storage Interface, Minecart Coupling; backpack to Gold (63 slots)
siftec.node.label: %s, %s
siftec.outfit.no_armour: Wear armour that takes a trim first
siftec.outfit.title: Customizer: your outfit
siftec.ponder.alien_power_augmenter.head: Alien Power Augmenter
siftec.ponder.alien_power_augmenter.text: The Alien Power Augmenter adds 500 MW to its grid and boosts the grid's generators by 10%, or 30% while it is fed Alien Power Matrices.
siftec.ponder.assembler.text_1: The Assembler combines two inputs into one part: a Mechanical Mixer over a Basin.
siftec.ponder.awesome_shop.text_1: The AWESOME Shop sells cosmetics for FICSIT Coupons, such as the Customizer for painting your buildings. Use its control panel to open it.
siftec.ponder.awesome_sink.text_1: The AWESOME Sink destroys whatever its input port takes, and pays FICSIT Coupons for it. Use it with something in hand to sink that.
siftec.ponder.billboard_large.text_1: A billboard 16 wide and 8 high (the AWESOME Shop's Billboard Set). Use the sign at the foot of its face to write on it.
siftec.ponder.billboard_large.text_2: The text fills the board; dye and glow ink colour and light it, as on a sign.
siftec.ponder.billboard_small.text_1: A billboard 8 wide and 4 high (the AWESOME Shop's Billboard Set). Use the sign at the foot of its face to write on it.
siftec.ponder.billboard_small.text_2: The text fills the board; dye and glow ink colour and light it, as on a sign.
siftec.ponder.biomass_burner.text_1: The Biomass Burner burns leaves, wood, mycelia, Biomass and Solid Biofuel for 30 MW. Fuel goes in at the back.
siftec.ponder.blender.text_1: The Blender mixes fluids and solids for the late-game chemistry: a heated Mixer over a Brass Basin, which holds four stacks of each item.
siftec.ponder.blueprint_designer.text_1: The Blueprint Designer is a build floor in a frame: the 9 by 9 by 9 cube over the floor is yours to build in, and anyone inside it can fly.
siftec.ponder.blueprint_designer.text_2: Click its terminal with paper to save what stands in the cube as a Blueprint; sneak-click it to clear the cube. Dismantling the Designer takes only the floor and frame: what you built inside stays where it is.
siftec.ponder.blueprint_designer_mk2.tex: The Blueprint Designer Mk.2 has a 13 by 13 by 13 cube to design in. It is a new building, not an upgrade: dismantle a Mk.1 and build the Mk.2 in its place.
Its terminal saves the cube with paper and clears it with a sneak-click, as the Mk.1's does.
siftec.ponder.blueprint_designer_mk3.tex: The Blueprint Designer Mk.3 has a 17 by 17 by 17 cube to design in, for the biggest blueprints.
Its terminal saves the cube with paper and clears it with a sneak-click; dismantling it leaves what you built inside.
siftec.ponder.coal_generator.text_1: The Coal Generator burns coal, Compacted Coal or Petroleum Coke for 75 MW, and takes 45 m3 of water a minute to do it.
siftec.ponder.constructor.text_1: The Constructor makes one part from one input: a Mechanical Press over a Basin, turned by its own motor.
siftec.ponder.converter.text_1: The Converter turns one resource into another with the help of SAM, and makes Ficsite, Diamonds and Time Crystals.
siftec.ponder.drone_port.text_1: The Drone Port is a landing pad on legs with its loading terminal underneath. Use the terminal to pick which of your company's ports its drone flies to.
siftec.ponder.drone_port.text_2: Packages go in at the back port and fire charges at the left one; what arrives comes out of the right one. The drone takes off from the pad with everything waiting, burning fire charges for the distance, and lands on the other pad.
siftec.ponder.equipment_workshop.text_1: The Equipment Workshop builds equipment by hand from the parts you carry. Use its control panel to open it.
siftec.ponder.explorer.text_1: The Explorer is the fastest vehicle on the planet, built for scouting rather than cargo: one row of storage. Right-click it to drive.
siftec.ponder.explorer.text_2: It burns Fuel, Liquid Biofuel or Turbofuel: use a bucket on it, or dock it at a Truck Station. Sneak and right-click for its storage.
siftec.ponder.explorer.text_3: Press V while driving to record a route through Truck Stations. Get out, and it drives the route by itself.
siftec.ponder.foundation_1m.text_1: An 8 by 8 foundation, one block thick. Foundations, walls and roofs snap to an 8-block grid so they line up.
siftec.ponder.foundation_1m.text_2: Use the Customizer on it for a material (Concrete, Grip Metal, Coated Concrete, Asphalt) or a floor pattern from the AWESOME Shop.
siftec.ponder.foundation_2m.text_1: An 8 by 8 foundation, two blocks thick, snapped to the 8-block grid.
siftec.ponder.foundation_2m.text_2: The Customizer gives it a material or a floor pattern bought in the AWESOME Shop.
siftec.ponder.foundation_4m.text_1: An 8 by 8 foundation, four blocks thick, snapped to the 8-block grid.
siftec.ponder.foundation_4m.text_2: The Customizer gives it a material or a floor pattern bought in the AWESOME Shop.
siftec.ponder.foundry.text_1: The Foundry makes steel and alloys: a Mechanical Mixer over a Basin, heated by a Blaze Burner the building keeps lit while it has power.
siftec.ponder.fuel_generator.text_1: The Fuel Generator burns Fuel, Liquid Biofuel, Turbofuel, Rocket Fuel or Ionized Fuel for 250 MW.
siftec.ponder.geothermal_generator.text_: The Geothermal Generator stands over a geyser and gives 200 MW for free, forever. It only goes down where a geyser vents.
siftec.ponder.hub.text_1: The HUB is where it all starts: the first thing every Pioneer builds with the Build Gun.
siftec.ponder.hub.text_2: Its terminal shows the milestones, and pays for them from what you carry. Beside it, the Craft Station's hand-cranked Press and Mixer make your first parts.
siftec.ponder.hub.text_3: Every HUB Upgrade adds to it: beds and lockers, Biomass Burners for power at the back, and at the last upgrade the freighter's dock tower.
siftec.ponder.hub.text_4: It is the company's base for the whole game. Its upgrades belong to the company, not to the building.
siftec.ponder.industrial_storage_contain: The Industrial Storage Container is the bigger Storage Container: two Item Vaults side by side.
siftec.ponder.manufacturer.text_1: The Manufacturer builds the most complex parts. The Mixer over the Brass Basin makes the recipe's Core first.
siftec.ponder.manufacturer.text_2: Then the Core travels along a row of Depots, and a Deployer over each adds the last of one input.
siftec.ponder.miner_mk1.text_1: The Miner Mk.1 drills a resource node for as long as it has power, each time the ore grows back.
siftec.ponder.miner_mk1.text_2: Ore drops down a chute to the output port at the front, ready for a belt.
siftec.ponder.miner_mk2.text_1: The Miner Mk.2 breaks the regrown ore twice as quickly as the Mk.1 and mines with Fortune III, so every node gives more.
siftec.ponder.miner_mk3.text_1: The Miner Mk.3 is FICSIT's fastest miner: it breaks the ore five times as quickly as the Mk.1, with Fortune V. Its 45 MW takes a second motor, in the extension at the back.
siftec.ponder.nuclear_power_plant.text_1: The Nuclear Power Plant gives 2,500 MW from Uranium or Plutonium Fuel Rods, and takes 240 m3 of water a minute.
siftec.ponder.nuclear_power_plant.text_2: Every spent rod leaves nuclear waste behind, which has to go somewhere.
siftec.ponder.oil_extractor.text_1: The Oil Extractor stands over an oil node and pumps crude oil into its tank. Pure nodes give more, impure ones less.
siftec.ponder.packager.text_1: The Packager puts fluids into canisters and tanks, and takes them out again: a Spout over a Depot fills, and an Item Drain empties.
siftec.ponder.particle_accelerator.text_: The Particle Accelerator smashes particles together for the rarest materials, such as Plutonium and Nuclear Pasta. It draws a lot of power.
siftec.ponder.portable_miner.text_1: The Portable Miner is a small drill rig for the very first ores. It needs no power at all.
siftec.ponder.portable_miner.text_2: Set it over a resource node: it mines the node each time the ore grows back, and drops what it digs on the ground in front.
siftec.ponder.power_pole_mk1.text_1: Power Poles carry power across the factory: each wire from its connector joins two parts of the grid. A Mk.1 takes up to 4 wires.
siftec.ponder.power_pole_mk2.text_1: The Power Pole Mk.2 takes up to 7 wires.
siftec.ponder.power_pole_mk3.text_1: The Power Pole Mk.3 takes up to 10 wires.
siftec.ponder.power_storage.text_1: Power Storage keeps the power the grid does not use, and gives it back when the generators cannot keep up.
siftec.ponder.power_tower.text_1: The Power Tower lifts the grid high above the ground and takes up to 10 wires, for long runs between distant parts of the factory.
siftec.ponder.quantum_encoder.text_1: The Quantum Encoder works like the Manufacturer, with two extra steps: a Spout fills the Core with Excited Photonic Matter first, and an Item Drain takes the Dark Matter Residue off what comes out.
siftec.ponder.radar_tower.text_1: The Radar Tower clears the company's map over a wide area around it while it has power.
siftec.ponder.refinery.text_1: The Refinery turns crude oil into plastic, rubber, fuel and more: a heated Mixer over a Basin, with fluid ports for pipes.
siftec.ponder.resource_well_extractor.te: The Resource Well Extractor takes nitrogen gas from a well while a Resource Well Pressurizer near it is running.
The Resource Well Pressurizer stands over a nitrogen well and puts it under pressure, so the Resource Well Extractors around it can work.
siftec.ponder.roof_4m.text_1: A roof over 8 by 8, rising four blocks toward the back, snapped to the 8-block grid.
siftec.ponder.roof_4m.text_2: The Customizer gives it the Tar, Metal or Glass roof material from the AWESOME Shop.
siftec.ponder.shared.cost: Build it with the Build Gun from the %s tab: it costs %s
siftec.ponder.shared.dismantle: Only the Build Gun's dismantle mode (X) takes it down, giving back its whole cost and whatever is inside
siftec.ponder.shared.fluid_out: Fluid comes out here, ready for a pipe
siftec.ponder.shared.fuse: If the grid takes more than it gets, the fuse blows: sneak and use a generator's control panel to reset it
siftec.ponder.shared.item_in: Belts and funnels bring items in here
siftec.ponder.shared.node: It stands over a resource node. Mine the node's clump away first; aimed near the node, the Build Gun snaps it on
siftec.ponder.shared.panel: Its control panel: use it to see what the building is doing
siftec.ponder.shared.panel_filter: Use the control panel with an item to set what it makes, and sneak-use it to clear that
siftec.ponder.shared.power_make: It feeds %s MW (%s SU) into the grid it is wired to
siftec.ponder.shared.power_use: It runs on power: it draws %s SU from the grid it is wired to
siftec.ponder.shared.power_wire: Wire it to the grid from the connector on top
siftec.ponder.shared.vehicle_cost: Put it down with the Build Gun from the %s tab: it costs %s
siftec.ponder.smelter.text_1: The Smelter melts ore into ingots. Inside, a motor drives an Encased Fan that blows through lava onto a Depot: Create's bulk blasting.
siftec.ponder.storage_container.text_1: The Storage Container holds items in an Item Vault. Belt things in at the back and take them out at the front.
siftec.ponder.tag.power.description: Generators, poles and storage of the power grid
siftec.ponder.tag.production.description: SIFTEC's machines: miners, smelters, constructors and the rest of the factory
siftec.ponder.tag.special.description: The HUB, the Wormhole Gateway and the FICSIT services
siftec.ponder.tractor.text_1: The Tractor is a small, quick hauler with three rows of storage. Right-click it to drive: W and S for throttle, A and D to steer, Space to brake.
siftec.ponder.tractor.text_2: It burns Fuel, Liquid Biofuel or Turbofuel: use a bucket on it, or dock it at a Truck Station. Sneak and right-click for its storage.
siftec.ponder.tractor.text_3: Press V while driving to record a route through Truck Stations. Get out, and it drives the route by itself.
siftec.ponder.truck.text_1: The Truck is slower than the Tractor, but carries six rows of storage. Right-click it to drive.
siftec.ponder.truck.text_2: It burns Fuel, Liquid Biofuel or Turbofuel: use a bucket on it, or dock it at a Truck Station. Sneak and right-click for its storage.
siftec.ponder.truck.text_3: Press V while driving to record a route through Truck Stations. Get out, and it drives the route by itself.
siftec.ponder.truck_station.text_1: The Truck Station loads vehicles from its two Item Vaults, or unloads them into the vaults, while they stand at the dock in front of it.
siftec.ponder.truck_station.text_2: Its fuel tank fills up every vehicle that docks. Its terminal switches between loading and unloading.
siftec.ponder.wall_4m.text_1: A wall 8 wide and 4 high, snapped to the 8-block grid.
siftec.ponder.wall_4m.text_2: The Customizer gives it the Concrete or Steel wall material from the AWESOME Shop.
siftec.ponder.water_extractor.text_1: The Water Extractor stands in water and pumps 120 m3 a minute into its tank. The cell under its intake has to be a water source.
siftec.ponder.wormhole_gateway.text_1: The Wormhole Gateway is the colony's goal. It arrives as a bare platform with a delivery terminal and two power hookups.
siftec.ponder.wormhole_gateway.text_2: Each Wormhole Phase delivered at its terminal opens new HUB tiers and builds more of the ring gate.
siftec.ponder.wormhole_gateway.text_3: The fifth phase closes the circuit: the ring lights up and a portal to The Sift opens inside it.
siftec.portal.blocked: Something is standing in that portal's way
siftec.portal.gone: That portal is not there any more
siftec.portal.no_main: Portals need the company to have a Main Portal somewhere
siftec.portal.title: Portals
siftec.power.acid_full: acid tank full: pipe the sulfuric acid away
